description: Samples the picture and scores how much each sample differs from the previous one. High scores are cut or flash candidates (not editorial labels: check them with `frames` every_frame around each). Also reports how dynamic the video is overall.

end.description: Range end (default the end of the video).

rate.description: Samples per second; 10 or more to time cuts precisely.

source.description: The video: a link (YouTube and other sites), a path to a local file, or `inbox` for the newest file in the inbox folder.

threshold.description: Score from which a change is listed (0–1).

name: boundaries
title: Find where the picture changes
